remarks: Large and Luxe 2 BR, 2 FULL BTH, 1,080 sq ft open concept space with high ceilings, large windows, elevator building. Full kitchen equipped with entire range of SS appliances, abundant storage plus center island with bar seating. Combination living and dining room has entry to private deck. Primary BR suite features a large, deep walk-in closet and glass slider to deck, second BR also includes large, deep walk-in closet. In-unit washer and dryer. Beautiful grass courtyard surrounded by brick walkways and ornamental plantings, outdoor seating and grilling stations. Amenities: fitness room, club room, concierge, one reserved garage space. Excellent location, easy walkability and centered to downtown, Stamford Town Center, shopping, dining, entertainment and all exciting events the city is known all close by. All major transit hubs, public transportation and Metro North. Excellent credit and references required. Unit's tenant in the process of move-out, the unit will be completely painted and carpets professionally shampooed.
